items.headline: U.S. Futures Mixed as Investors Await Fed Minutes, Oil Prices Rise
items.summary: U.S. stock futures are showing mixed movements in early trading on Wednesday, August 19, 2026, as investors cautiously await the release of the Federal Reserve's latest FOMC minutes for insights into future interest rate policy. Elevated Middle East tensions are driving oil prices higher for the fourth consecutive day, while technology stocks continue to face selling pressure following Tuesday's declines.

items.statContext: Pre-market, Aug 19. Nasdaq Composite closed down 1.33% Tuesday.

items.headline: Moderna Surges on Vaccine Trial Success
items.summary: Moderna's stock surged 100% in early trading after its experimental mRNA-based vaccine for melanoma showed promising results in a late-stage trial.

items.headline: Merck Climbs as Moderna's Partner
items.summary: Merck, a partner in Moderna's melanoma vaccine development, saw its shares climb 8% following the positive trial news.

items.headline: Keysight Technologies Rises on Strong Guidance
items.summary: Keysight Technologies rose 3.06% in pre-market trading after reporting better-than-expected third-quarter financial results and issuing strong fourth-quarter guidance.

items.headline: Mercury Systems Drops After Mixed Report
items.summary: Mercury Systems dropped 10.76% in pre-market trading after reporting mixed financial results.

items.headline: SK Hynix Tumbles Amid Chip Selloff
items.summary: South Korean memory chipmaker SK Hynix fell 9.20% as AI-related stocks continued to decline amidst rising U.S.-Iran tensions and broader tech selloff.

items.headline: Target Slips Despite Beat
items.summary: Target shares were slipping in early trading despite the retailer reporting better-than-expected second-quarter results and raising its sales growth forecast.

items.headline: FOMC Minutes in Focus Today
items.summary: Investors are keenly awaiting the release of the Federal Reserve's FOMC meeting minutes today, August 19, 2026, for detailed insights into the Fed's recent policy discussions and potential future interest rate decisions.

items.headline: Oil Prices Extend Gains on Middle East Tensions
items.summary: Brent crude is trading around $92.40 a barrel and WTI crude near $85.70 a barrel, extending a four-day rally. Rising Middle East tensions and supply concerns are fueling the gains.

items.headline: Tech Sector Continues to Lag; AI Stocks Face Pressure
items.summary: The technology sector is again lagging, with AI-related stocks resuming their decline. This follows a trend of tech stocks dragging down major indices in recent sessions, partly due to concerns over high valuations and rising bond yields.

items.headline: Key Retail and Tech Earnings Today
items.summary: Major companies including Lowe's ($LOW), Target ($TGT), TJX Companies ($TJX), and Analog Devices ($ADI) are scheduled to report earnings before market open today. Keysight Technologies ($KEYS) already reported strong results.

items.headline: Defense, Energy, and Private Banks Dragging Indian Market
items.summary: In the Indian market, Defense, Energy, and Private Banks are identified as lagging sectors today, while the IT sector shows some gains after a recent sell-off.
